_note: Hebrew pronunciation lexicon for templates/core/pron.py. 'words': plain spelling (no nikud) -> the exact vowelised spelling sent to TTS, used instead of Dicta's automatic nikud. Add a word here whenever the Hebrew ASR check (out/<id>.report.json transcript.misread) or Noam flags a misreading. 'masc_nouns': a number right before these nouns is read in the masculine form (שלושה ימים); otherwise feminine (שלוש שנים). 'phrases': several plain words -> their vowelised reading together (same number of words), for homographs that only context decides. A single tricky word can also be vowelised right in the spec's say text: subtitles strip the nikud. Default nikud mode is 'lex' (no automatic nikud): Cartesia reads plain Hebrew better than fully vowelised Hebrew (hevoice/audition_2a/2b.json, 20 Nov).
